trigger_conditions: Any frozen v0.05 mandatory gate fails or becomes blocked.
Frozen contract, evaluation-plan, or traceability-corpus integrity fails.
Any applicable inherited regression REG-0001 through REG-0006 fails or disappears without governance.
A critical traceability defect is discovered that invalidates the frozen evaluation result.
procedure: Keep all v0.05 candidate artifacts, failed runs, metrics, and regression records as audit history.
Restore v0.04 as the active promoted-experimental executable baseline.
Preserve REG-0007 and DEF-005-001 even when rolling back, because the failure occurred and remains regression memory.
Do not alter REL-0.05-FROZEN-001, its corpus, or its evaluation plan; create a governed retry/successor contract instead.
data_loss_expectation: None. v0.05 evidence remains preserved; executable active baseline reverts to v0.04.
